description: baseline: EfficientNet-B2 full fine-tune (timm, ImageNet pretrained) with AdamW + cosine LR for 40 epochs — Tier C choice for N=16,200 satellite imagery (EuroSAT-style 10-class land-use), with ImageNet normalization, flip/jitter/erase augmentation, and standard CrossEntropy (class ratio 1.56×, below focal-loss threshold)

Upgraded backbone to ConvNeXt-Tiny (28M params, stronger than EfficientNet-B2), added CutMix augmentation (cutmix_alpha=1.0, prob=0.5) with SoftTargetCrossEntropy + label smoothing=0.1, enabled AMP mixed precision for faster training, and added 3-view TTA (original + h-flip + v-flip) at validation — targeting ~97.5-98.5% F1 vs baseline 96.2%

Switched backbone to EfficientNetV2-S (21.5M params, ImageNet top-1=83.9% vs ConvNeXt-Tiny 82.1%), added 90°-multiple rotation augmentation (valid for nadir satellite imagery), combined Mixup+CutMix (switch_prob=0.5), added linear warmup (5 epochs) before cosine decay, and expanded TTA from 3-view to 5-view (adding rot90/rot270)

Switched backbone from ConvNeXt V1-Tiny to ConvNeXt V2-Tiny (same 28M params, same speed, but improved GRN architecture + FCMAE pretraining → 82.9% vs 82.1% IN1K top-1), expanded TTA from 3-view to 5-view (adding rot90/rot270 valid for nadir satellite imagery), replaced 15° random rotation with 90°-aligned discrete rotations in training augmentation, and added 5-epoch linear warmup for training stability.

Switched backbone to convnext_small.dinov3_lvd1689m (50M params, DINOv3 self-supervised pretraining on 1.689B images) — 119× more pretraining data than current IN22K model, faster per-batch (61ms vs 65ms at 64×64), with time-safety stop at 1720s added as guard

Added SWA (Stochastic Weight Averaging, epochs 32-40) to average model weights from multiple checkpoints for flatter minima, and expanded TTA from 5-view to 8-view D4 symmetry group (complete dihedral group: 4 rotations × 2 reflections) — estimated +0.05-0.2% improvement with ~1547s runtime (within budget)

Added EMA (ModelEmaV2 decay=0.9998) for smoother weight averaging at inference, replaced plain Resize with RandomResizedCrop(scale=0.75-1.0) to add scale variation, and removed continuous RandomRotation(10) that conflicted with discrete 90°-aligned rotations and introduced blur artifacts in satellite imagery

Expanded TTA from 5-view to complete 8-view D4 dihedral group (adding rot180, transpose, anti-transpose) and switched from softmax to logit averaging — isolating the TTA change from exp 5 which conflated it with SWA

Switched to convnextv2_tiny.fcmae_ft_in22k_in1k_384 (same 28M params but IN22K supervised pretraining with 21K categories for richer feature representations) and added layer-wise LR decay (LLRD, decay=0.8) assigning smaller LR to earlier layers to better preserve general features during fine-tuning
